title: Haloumi and Mixed Grain Salad
subtitle: with Sweet Leek Dressing
description: With a trio of wholesome grains – rice, barley and quinoa – plus pumpkin, sweet leek and currants topped with fried haloumi, this super salad is super satisfying.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the grain blend. Cut the unpeeled pumpkin into 1cm-thick wedges, discarding the seeds, if any (see Kitchen tips). Thinly slice the leek. Crush 1 garlic clove. Cut three-quarters of the haloumi into 5mm-thick slices (see Kitchen tips).

Cook grain blend: Cook the grain blend in the pan of boiling water for 20-22 mins until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, put the pumpkin on the lined tray, spray or brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 20 mins or until golden and tender.
Make dressing: Meanwhile, put the garlic, 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 1 tsp dijon mustard in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Pick the mint leaves.

Cook leek: Spray or brush a medium frypan with olive oil and heat over medium heat. Cook the leek and 1 tbs water, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until softened. Add the currants, 1 tbs water, 2 tsp white wine vinegar and 1 tsp honey, season with salt and pepper and cook for a further 2 mins or until slightly caramelised. Remove from the pan and wipe clean.

Fry haloumi and serve up: Spray or brush the pan with olive oil and heat over high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1 min each side or until golden. Remove from the heat. Add the grain blend and leek mixture to the dressing and toss gently to combine. Divide the grain salad, pumpkin and haloumi among plates. Scatter over the mint leaves and enjoy!

Kitchen tips: The pumpkin skin is edible but you can peel it prior to cooking if you prefer. To keep this dish healthy, we have only used three-quarters of the haloumi, but it would be equally delicious if you choose to use it all.
